papers.title: Understanding the interaction between human and LLMs-based AI in creative tasks: Insights from UX professionals' collaboration and communication with ChatGPT
papers.abstract: Large Language Model applications (LLMs), such as ChatGPT, have showcased their remarkable capability in creative tasks with exceptionally human-like responses. To effectively integrate LLMs in creativity-related activities, further research is needed to understand how humans interact with LLMs in creative contexts. This study investigates how UX professionals collaborate and communicate with ChatGPT in creative design tasks, identifying key interaction patterns and design implications for human-AI collaborative systems.
papers.summary_ja: UXプロフェッショナルがCreativeタスクでChatGPTとどのように協働するかを実証的に調査し、人間とLLMの相互作用パターンを解明した研究。デザイン実務においてAIを効果的に統合するための知見を提供する。

papers.title: Navigating digital servitization in manufacturing SMEs through value propositions
papers.abstract: Purpose: The purpose of this study is to understand how manufacturing small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) can navigate digital servitization to cocreate value propositions. Design/methodology/approach: The present exploratory study interviewed managers from 18 manufacturing SMEs holding managerial roles. The study uses a qualitative abductive approach. Findings: The study identifies how digital servitization enables SMEs to shift from product-centric to service-oriented value propositions through iterative co-creation with customers.
papers.summary_ja: 製造業SMEがデジタルサービタイゼーションを通じて価値提案を再構築するプロセスを18社のインタビューで解明。製品中心からサービス指向への移行における価値共創メカニズムを実証的に示す。

papers.title: Making sense of wickedness: Directionality heuristics for challenge-led innovation policy
papers.abstract: This article contributes to the burgeoning literature on directionality challenges by introducing directionality heuristics as a lens to conceptualize how policymakers and other stakeholders interpret and respond to problems in challenge-led innovation policy. Our starting point is that the 'wickedness' of problems is strongly shaped by subjective and context-specific perceptions. We therefore utilize a framing perspective to unpack the intersubjective processes through which stakeholders co-construct and navigate wicked problems in innovation policy.
papers.summary_ja: 「よこしまな問題（Wicked Problems）」に対して、イノベーション政策立案者がどのように方向性ヒューリスティクスを活用して問題を解釈し対応するかを概念化した理論的研究。課題主導型イノベーション政策のフレーミング理論に新たな視座を提示する。

papers.title: Bringing Back Intuition into Scenario Planning
papers.abstract: Intuitive logics is a prominent scenario planning method of strategic foresight that organizations use to plan in the context of uncertain future operating environments. Designed to counter linear forecasting approaches, intuitive logics is a method for envisioning and embracing multiple futures. Rooted in the works of Herman Kahn and Pierre Wack in military and corporate contexts, intuitive logics has since become widely adopted in corporate and public sector planning. This paper revisits the role of intuition in scenario planning and proposes an enhanced framework that integrates intuitive cognition with analytical rigor.
papers.summary_ja: シナリオプランニングの「直感的論理」手法において直感の役割を再評価し、分析的厳密さと直感的認知を統合した拡張フレームワークを提案。不確実な未来に備える戦略的フォーサイト実践に向けた新しい視点を提供する。

papers.title: Value co-creation: capturing the causal complexity of organizational capabilities
papers.abstract: Purpose: Service firms have the crucial responsibility of enabling value co-creation for their own and their customers' benefit. Therefore, it is imperative to gain a deeper understanding of how the organizational capabilities instilled in service interactions relate to the co-created value outcomes. Design/methodology/approach: This study employs a configurational approach using fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis (fsQCA) to examine the causal complexity of organizational capabilities required for value co-creation in service contexts.
papers.summary_ja: サービス企業における価値共創のための組織能力の因果的複雑性をfsQCA（ファジー集合型質的比較分析）によって実証分析。どの能力の組み合わせが価値共創成果につながるかをコンフィギュレーション的に解明する。

papers.title: Categorizing realist, critical, and pragmatist perspectives on innovation ecosystems: A research agenda and an initial application to artificial intelligence
papers.abstract: While discourses on innovation ecosystems have become popular in academia, policy, and practice, they often take place in disciplinary silos and are marked by ambiguity. To address these issues, this research note categorizes the rapidly growing literature on innovation ecosystems into realist, critical, and pragmatist perspectives. It draws out their diverging assumptions about the nature of ecosystems, knowledge, and research goals, and provides an initial application to artificial intelligence ecosystems.
papers.summary_ja: イノベーションエコシステム論を「リアリスト・批判的・プラグマティスト」の3視座に分類整理し、AIエコシステムへの適用を通じて各視座の違いを明確化したレビュー研究。エコシステム戦略の学際的議論を整理するフレームワークを提供する。

papers.title: The anatomy of failed historical transitions: An approach to expand the study of socio-technical change
papers.abstract: Transition research has yielded substantial insight regarding how large-scale changes in systems unfold but has paid comparatively little attention to failed transitions: historical episodes where efforts to adjust socio-technical systems did not result in systemic change. Despite calls to attend to these failures, analytical challenges continue to hold back engagement with this fertile empirical territory. This paper proposes an analytical framework for studying failed historical transitions, drawing on historical cases to develop typologies of failure modes in socio-technical transitions.
papers.summary_ja: 社会技術システムの大規模変革研究において見落とされてきた「失敗した移行」を歴史的視点から分析する枠組みを提案。失敗パターンの類型化を通じて、トランジションデザインと変革管理に重要な示唆を与える。

papers.title: Applied Speculations in the Baggage Hall: Transdisciplinary Thinking around Robotic Work Futures
papers.abstract: Robotic technologies are often proposed to relieve dull, dirty, or dangerous work, but may cause work to instead be experienced as boring, or dehumanized. Understanding the impact of robotics on the workfloor is complicated by the entanglement between emerging robotic capabilities, social dynamics, and organizational issues—which we call Worker–Robot Relations. Consequently, the impact of robotics on workers cannot be predicted based solely on technical affordances. This paper presents a speculative design workshop applied in an airport baggage handling context to explore future worker-robot relations in a transdisciplinary manner.
papers.summary_ja: 空港手荷物処理施設を舞台に、ロボット技術の導入が労働者にどう影響するかをスペキュラティブデザインワークショップで探索した実践的ケーススタディ。学際的思考とデザインフィクションを組み合わせたロボット労働未来の共創手法を示す。

papers.title: Digital innovation ecosystem: a systematic mapping to understand how digital technologies are transforming innovation ecosystem
papers.abstract: This study presents a systematic mapping of the digital innovation ecosystem literature to understand how digital technologies are transforming innovation ecosystems. The analysis synthesizes research on platform economics, digital transformation, and ecosystem governance to identify key themes, emerging trends, and research gaps in this rapidly evolving field.
papers.summary_ja: デジタル技術がイノベーションエコシステムをどのように変革しているかを体系的マッピングで整理したレビュー論文。プラットフォーム経済・デジタル変革・エコシステムガバナンスの主要テーマと研究ギャップを包括的に示す。

papers.title: Mapping the Intellectual Structure and Evolution of Systems Thinking: A Bibliometric Analysis of Problem and Solution Domains
papers.abstract: Addressing today's interconnected challenges requires moving beyond linear thinking. Although theoretical taxonomies of systems thinking (ST) exist, there is a need to empirically validate how these concepts manifest in academic practice. This study employs science mapping (VOSviewer tool), utilising bibliometric data from 7119 Scopus documents (1974–2024), to visualise the field's intellectual structure and evolution. We identify core problem domains (where ST is applied) and solution domains (how ST is applied) through bibliometric clustering.
papers.summary_ja: システム思考の学術的発展を7119件のScopus文献データを用いた書誌計量分析で可視化した包括的レビュー。問題領域と解決手法の知的構造を体系的にマッピングし、50年間の分野進化を明らかにする。
